scope.benchmark: P2 f/1.4, same saved geometry/observations/F2 for both Query versions

prep.input: B native frozen depth sampled to 256, C native 256 frozen depth, 5 observed source frames
prep.labels: 256/5 fields with B peeled color/identity and native K16 nearest-center labels; C peeled labels and exact analytic K16 recast with five views
prep.B_recoverability: five selected GT raster witness views, compared by surface identity and projected depth
prep.reveal_cases: two archived nominal f/1.4 focal distances per frame; no additional focal sweep
prep.training_change: old GT-input warmup omitted; exact balanced 70/30 interleaving from step one
prep.monitor: B 15 development scenes and 10 deterministic C development scenes

first_pass.pooling: sum TP, FP and FN over all 15 development scenes and 13 label frames
first_pass.tie_break: less GT-interior b=1, then squared distance to epsilon=.05 and q_min=.5

first_pass_tolerant.distance: Chebyshev pixel distance (5x5 square dilation at 2 px), matching the project boundary band
first_pass_tolerant.precision_support: b=1 within valid GT boundary dilation / all b=1
first_pass_tolerant.recall_support: valid GT boundary pixels within 2 px of a b=1 pixel / valid GT boundary pixels
first_pass_tolerant.pooling: sum pixel counts before calculating precision, recall and F1
first_pass_tolerant.tie_break: lowest proportion over 5 px, then squared distance to epsilon=.05 and q_min=.5

first_pass_final.distance: Chebyshev pixel distance (5x5 square dilation at 2 px), matching the project boundary band
first_pass_final.precision_support: b=1 within valid GT boundary dilation / all b=1
first_pass_final.recall_support: valid GT boundary pixels within 2 px of a b=1 pixel / valid GT boundary pixels
first_pass_final.pooling: sum pixel counts before calculating precision, recall and F1
first_pass_final.tie_break: lowest proportion over 5 px, then squared distance to epsilon=.05 and q_min=.5
first_pass_final.gt_interior: valid opaque GT outside the ±2 px square boundary band
first_pass_final.zero_q_min: 第一遍拆分只由 α̂ 决定，Query 可信度不作门限。原深度约束保持。
